core_obligations: Part (1): immediate from the perfect-preservation lemma part (4). Part (2): composition formula plus perfectness of the convolution kernel.

Part (3): the abstract right adjoint has kernel RSheafHom(K, a(O_Y)); the dualizing base change gives a(O_Y) = Lpr_1^* omega; perfect duality identifies the kernel with Lpr_1^* omega tensor K^vee; Gorenstein makes omega invertible, so K^prime is perfect.
Part (4): mirror of (3) with the left adjoint lemma.
proof_roadmap: Run the two reductions, then the adjoint kernel identification; part (4) mirrors part (3).
difficulty_reason: Parts (1)-(2) reduce to in-batch cards; parts (3)-(4) carry real kernel identification (dualizing base change, Gorenstein invertibility) with a mirror-level part (4).
